From: ramishqureshi99@gmail.com <ramishqureshi99@gmail.com>
Sent: 08 October 2026 15:25
To: Victoria Cuff <victoria@bafsa.org.uk>
Subject: Nexora demo for BAFSA's membership administration

You don't often get email from ramishqureshi99@gmail.com. Learn why this is important<https://aka.ms/LearnAboutSenderIdentification>

Hi Victoria,

I'm contacting you about BAFSA's membership administration, particularly the connection between member-company records, their contacts and member services.

We've built Nexora, a membership management platform for associations. It brings those records together with membership applications, staff review and member self-service, helping staff follow the same member journey across their workspace and portal.

Nexora also supports an AI assistant inside the CRM workspace. When enabled, your team can access AI assistance alongside their day-to-day membership work.

I've attached a 90-second narrated demonstration of Nexora. It also has on-screen captions, so you can watch it with or without sound.

We're inviting a small number of associations to explore a focused evaluation around their membership process. Would you be open to a 15-minute conversation to see whether there's a useful fit for BAFSA?

Best,
Ramish Qureshi
Founder, Nexora
ramishqureshi99@gmail.com<mailto:ramishqureshi99@gmail.com>

I found this contact on your association's public website. If this isn't relevant, reply 'no thanks' and I won't follow up.
